rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
fused sandhi form: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulaṃ; compound identifying attainment of powers with the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula together with the eight attainments?
premises: The eight attainments are enumerated as a complete set.
The attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
This identification is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight powers is declared to be the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The specific eight siddhis are not named in this verse and rely on prior context.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
